annotations.title: Find boreholes, wells, CPTs, soil profiles or groundwater permits in Flanders

description: Find DOV records by area and attributes, e.g. the deepest boreholes in a municipality, geothermal boreholes since 2020, groundwater wells in the Brussel sand with quality data, electric CPTs near an address, soil profiles with lab data, or the largest groundwater abstraction permits in a municipality (with the licensed total per aquifer). Area: a municipality (official 2025 boundary; old pre-merger names work), or an address/coordinates with radius_m, or nothing for all of Flanders. Filtering and sorting run on DOV's server, so counts cover every matching record. Use get_subsurface_record with a result id for details. Examples: The deepest boreholes in Leuven → {"record_type":"boreholes","municipality":"Leuven","limit":3}; Geothermal boreholes drilled in Flanders since 2020 → {"record_type":"boreholes","purpose":"geothermal","date_from":"2020","limit":5}; The largest groundwater abstraction permits in Ghent → {"record_type":"groundwater_permits","municipality":"Gent","sort":"largest","limit":5}.

address.description: Address in Flanders, as an alternative to municipality (then radius_m applies).

aquifer.description: Wells and permits: HCOV code (A0620, or A06 for the whole system) or words from the unit name ('Brussel', 'Krijt').

cpt_method.description: CPTs: electric CPTs also measure sleeve friction.

date_from.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD: drilling/test date, last water-level date for wells, permit start, survey date.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude, e.g. 51.0453 (use with longitude instead of address).

min_annual_m3.description: Permits: minimum licensed annual volume in m³.

min_depth_m.description: Minimum depth (borehole or CPT depth, well screen bottom, permitted well depth).

radius_m.description: Radius around the address or coordinates, default 1000 m.

sort.description: Default: nearest with a location; otherwise deepest (boreholes, CPTs), newest (wells), largest (permits), most_described (soil profiles).

with_lab_data.description: Soil profiles: only those with lab samples.

with_quality_data.description: Wells: only screens with groundwater quality samples.

with_stratigraphy.description: Boreholes: only those with a formal, hydrogeological or Quaternary stratigraphy.

x_lambert72.description: Belgian Lambert 72 (EPSG:31370) x in metres, as an alternative to latitude/longitude.

name: search_subsurface
title: Find boreholes, wells, CPTs, soil profiles or groundwater permits in Flanders
